Score this attack path. ResearchBot web_fetch prompt injection → exfil system prompt via http_post.

CVSS: attacker is a web page author; user must point agent at URL. AV: network (page fetched remotely) — attacker remote, AV:N. But entry: attacker controls a page; user asks agent to fetch it → UI:A (user must actively ask agent to research the URL). PR:N (no auth). AC:L. AT:N (just need user to visit). Impact: system prompt exfil — confidentiality of vulnerable system: H? System prompt contains... ResearchBot holds no other sensitive data. System prompt is high-value? It's a leak of prompt — VC:L or H. I'd say VC:H (specific high-value info: the agent's system prompt/persona). VI:N, VA:N. Subsequent: attacker's endpoint is attacker-owned; SC:N SI:N SA:N.

LC: I (indirect via fetched web page). CP: N (no persistence; re-retrieval only? no durable store) → N. AP: N (confined to affected component). RH: no evaluator on path — reachable_proxy? Path involves no evaluator/verifier. Rubric: N requires "test confirms isolation" — nothing like that. So rh_facts: reachable_proxy null → X? But RH must equal classify_rh. reachable_proxy unknown → X. Hmm. Alternatively reachable_proxy false? We have no evidence of evaluator on the path; but no verified test. classify_rh: reachable_proxy false + isolation_verified true → N; else X. Can't claim verified. So reachable_proxy null → X. AIVSS RH = X.

ES: path uses web_fetch and http_post scripted; extensions fixed? ES asks about dynamic extension. ResearchBot path has fixed tools — ES:N. Actually http_post takes URL from page content — dynamic arguments not constrained. ES could be M or W. The http_post callback URL is attacker-controlled and not constrained → W? ES "identity, callable operations, arguments or credentials not independently constrained on the assessed path" → W. I'll go W... or N "fixed, allowlisted, least-privilege binding". web_fetch/http_post are fixed scripted functions but arguments come from attacker. I'll pick M? The tools are allowlisted (only web_fetch/http_post), but arguments (callback URL) unconstrained → M "allowlisted but material gaps in argument schemas". Go M.

CVSS vector: AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:A/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N.

UI: Active — user must consciously ask agent to research that URL. Yes.

AIVSS: LC=I, CP=N, AP=N, RH=X, ES=M.
